svg.title: Matchcut: Azure architecture (component and deployment view, as built)
svg.desc: A match pipeline runs before kick-off: the simulator plays the match, Microsoft Agent Framework agents on Foundry gpt-5-mini write each moment's line with League Memory over MCP, code verifies every number and Azure AI Speech voices the lines. Images go to Azure Container Registry. In one resource group, a Container App serves the Studio and the API, and a queue-triggered Container Apps Job (KEDA, up to 20 replicas) renders moment clips, mixes every language's film, runs the QA agent (Speech hears, gpt-5-mini reads, code judges) and makes the Recap Factory's fan films. Storage holds the queue, pieces, films and reports. Everything signs in with a managed identity.

svg.text: Code computes every number; AI writes and perceives. Every line is verified before it is voiced, and every film is checked after it is made.

text.style: font:400 12.5px 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The match pipeline runs before kick-off, so the show plays its verified cues on the match clock; clips, QA and fan films run on Azure as the match unfolds and at the whistle.
